newsitem.title: ITALY: North African immigrants to be thrown out of Italy.
newsitem.headline: North African immigrants to be thrown out of Italy.

text.p: A large group of North Africans immigrants will be expelled from Italy later on Friday, hours after they were nearly shipwrecked off the island of Lampedusa, police said.
The 99 illegal aliens, mostly Tunisians and Moroccans, were forced to take refuge on the tiny island south of Sicily after their two boats risked sinking in stormy seas.
Police said the Africans had been trying to get to Italy.
They were ferried to Sicily and police said they would be sent back at once to Tunisia where their boats had come from.
Separately, 14 Pakistanis and three Bangladeshis trying to reach Italy illegally were held by the coast guard in the northeast town of Chioggia after they crossed the Adriatic on a boat from Greece.
The officials said in a statement that the 17 would be sent back to Greece on the same boat later on Friday.
